ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area (approximately 85-90%) with localized high-intensity (white/light-grey) clusters (approximately 10-15%) primarily on distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling and focal spots concentrated on the distal 20% of the left and right lobes; distinct white pixel clusters are mapped to the extreme lateral tips and upper trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression visible at the central convergence point between the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration pattern featuring a series of sharp, triangular peaks and valleys along the entire visible trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep of the trailing edge terminating in tapered, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible clusters of circular white pixel aggregates (rosettes) located on the distal margins of both lobes, particularly prominent on the right lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct circular scarring patterns consistent with parasitic attachment marks visible on the dark pigmented surfaces of both distal lobe regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced irregular jaggedness of the trailing edge serrations compared to typical smooth-lobed specimens.
